title: Enumeration of Factor Occurrences in $k$-Bonacci Words over an Infinite Alphabet
summary: We study the $k$-Bonacci word over the infinite alphabet $\mathbb{N}$. Since the alphabet is infinite, the usual factor complexity is infinite and does not provide any information. We therefore investigate factor occurrence statistics in the finite iterates. For $k \ge 3$, we obtain closed forms for the generating functions (with respect to the iteration index) that count the number of occurrences of an arbitrary digit in the $n$th iterate.
